session_11_decisions.decision: Table scheduling alone is useful but insufficient: best same-session benchmark was k=9 / 256 KiB at n=4096 with about 1.061x over production, still directionally about 1.54x behind M4RI. Downstream 8e305c21 should treat it as evidence/input, not the sole production fix.

Production M4RM now uses adaptive target-row Gray-table budgets and a single-table update path. Evidence shows n=1024 at 1.18x slower than M4RI and n=4096 at the 1.50x threshold on the longer repeat run; margin is narrow and should be tracked by future perf gates.

Blocked left-to-right RREF closes all pinned GF(2) echelon rows for n in {64,256,1024} across uniform and rank-deficient regimes. Right-to-left pivoting must keep full-row XOR semantics for generator/parity compatibility; suffix-only XOR is valid only for the left-to-right blocked path.
